name: Kuro Usagi
source:
A black rabbit with white ears. Kuro can frequently be seen carrying his pocket watch, rushing around and agonising over the time. He has a terrible personality and regularly berates or insults those around him. As a result, Kuro doesn't have any friends. When he's irritated or stressed, he has a habit of biting his nails. He was once a completely white rabbit, but stress caused his fur to turn black. Unpleased with his black fur, his constant rushing around has warped him and left him desiring death.

[Based on the [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/alice/#chara1]official website's character profile[/URL].]
